spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.s: Stargrave Singularity

Conjures a ten-second black hole at the aimed position, dragging every living creature except the caster and spectators within 20 blocks toward its core. Its collapse deals true damage equal to 90% of each target's maximum health, ignoring armor, shields, resistance, and invulnerability. Cooldown: 600 seconds.
Radius: 20 blocks | Damage: 90% of target maximum health | Cooldown: 600s

spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.s: Starless

Opens a void at the aimed position that swallows light for 13 seconds, dimming every other spell light within 12 blocks and draining the colour from the world inside it. Light starvation deals true damage equal to 18% of each enemy's maximum health; the collapse then releases everything it took as a white detonation for a further 30%, rising to 50% for each nearby spell light it consumed. Radius: 12 blocks. Cooldown: 300 seconds.
Radius: 12 blocks | Damage: 48-68% maximum health | Cooldown: 300s | Mana: 1400
spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.c: Calls down a star that settles into a wide orbit above the aimed point, dragging a long sweeping shadow from everything it passes. Its gravity hauls creatures within 14 blocks toward it, and anything it holds burns for true damage and catches fire — the closer it is dragged, the harder it burns. After twelve seconds the star burns out. Cooldown: 300 seconds.
Orbit: 9 blocks | Gravity: 14 blocks | Burn: 2.4%-10% max health per second (by proximity) | Duration: 12s | Cooldown: 300s | Mana: 1400

spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.s: Silhouette

Holds the light inside out. While channelled, every bright surface within 32 blocks turns to black silhouette and every surface in shadow glows instead. Enemies within 32 blocks that are not standing near one of your spell lights take 4% of their maximum health each second. Cooldown: 240 seconds.
Field: 32 blocks | Shadow damage: 4% max health/s | Channelled | Cooldown: 240s | Mana: 1000
Starfall

Calls a ten-second meteor bombardment over a 14 block area. Meteors cut in at a 30 degree slant, shedding shock rings and dragging long incandescent trails, each a moving light, and each strike deals 4% of a target’s maximum health within 2.5 blocks. One enormous meteor closes the barrage, falling 96 blocks onto the aimed point for 30% within 9 blocks. Standing still is what makes it lethal. Cooldown: 360 seconds.
Area: 14 blocks | ~40 meteors × 4% | Finale: colossal meteor, 30% within 9 blocks | Cooldown: 360s | Mana: 1600
Sky Collapse

Splits the sky. A rift tears open from overhead and runs to both horizons, pouring light out of the gap, and then the dome itself comes apart: six enormous shards tumble down in turn, each dealing 7% of a target's maximum health within 6 blocks. A keystone 36 blocks across lands last on the aimed point for 34% within 14 blocks, and the fracture seals as it hits. Cooldown: 420 seconds.
Area: 20 blocks | Shards: 6 × 7%, 6 blocks | Keystone: 34%, 14 blocks | Cooldown: 420s | Mana: 1700

spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.s: Stellar Convergence

Nine stars of different colours light one after another, hanging above the aimed point in a constellation. Each is a separate light, so the ground fills with nine overlapping coloured shadows that sweep as the stars drift. After about five seconds arcs link them into a net that contracts and turns, and then all nine pour into the centre at once as a column running from sky to ground, dealing 6% of maximum health per second to anything inside it. The column finally detonates for 42% within 12 blocks. Cooldown: 400 seconds.
Constellation: 22 blocks | Column: 6%/s, 6 blocks | Burst: 42%, 12 blocks | Cooldown: 400s | Mana: 1650

spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.s: Second Sun

Raises a second sun on the bearing you are facing. An enormous white disc climbs out of the horizon and fills a good part of the sky — a real light source, so everything in the world casts a second shadow that swings round as it rises. It holds high, cooling from white through gold to red as it swells, scorching enemies within 26 blocks. After about eleven seconds it goes supernova: the screen washes out, everything within 26 blocks takes 55% of its maximum health and catches fire, and the remnant collapses and goes out. Cooldown: 600 seconds.
Scorch: 26 blocks, 2% max health / 0.75s | Supernova: 55%, 26 blocks | Duration: 16s | Cooldown: 600s | Mana: 2000

spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.s: Singularity

Opens a singularity at the aimed point. It begins to contract, and over six seconds its gravity, its light and the rate it lashes lightning outward all accelerate together: everything within 20 blocks is hauled toward the core and crushed for 0.8%-4% of its maximum health every half second, harder the closer it is dragged. Then it collapses, dealing 62% of maximum health within 18 blocks, throwing everything outward, and leaving three decelerating shockwaves to pass through. Cooldown: 480 seconds.
Gravity: 20 blocks | Crush: 0.8%-4% max health / 0.5s | Collapse: 62%, 18 blocks | Charge: 6s | Cooldown: 480s | Mana: 1800

spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.l: A body ninety blocks long swims in from the distance, a wave travelling down its length rather than a shape sliding across the sky. The spine arrives first, then the flanks fill out and the scales close over it — anything the body passes through takes 6% of its maximum health every 0.3 seconds and is thrown aside. After about six seconds the head rears, the jaws gape on their recurved fangs, and it bites once on the aimed point for 52% within 9 blocks before the body tears apart into streaming light. Cooldown: 440 seconds.
Body: 90 blocks | Sweep: 6% max health / 0.3s, 5 blocks | Bite: 52%, 9 blocks | Cooldown: 440s | Mana: 1750

spell.irons_spellbooks_light_pollution.w: Plants a seed of light in the ground at the aimed point. A buttressed trunk 34 blocks tall spears up first, hitting everything within 7 blocks for 28% of its maximum health and pinning it in place. Seven roots then push out of the buttresses and race across the real terrain — climbing slopes and crossing ledges — dealing 5% within 3.2 blocks; only the advancing tips strike. Five orders of branches extend and turn up at the tips, thousands of stained-glass leaves fill the twigs, and the crown closes over into real shade before a final pulse deals 34% within 20 blocks. The whole tree hardens into pale crystal and stands for another dozen seconds before fading. Cooldown: 460 seconds.
Roots: 22 blocks, 5% per strike | Trunk: 28%, 7 blocks, pins | Crown: 34%, 20 blocks | Height: 34 blocks | Cooldown: 460s | Mana: 1750
